data.title: JPMorgan Reportedly Spots Bitcoin ‘Capitulation’ Signal in Michael Saylor’s Strategy as MSTR Stock Hits 52-Week Low
data.description: JPMorgan analysts reportedly said on Wednesday, November 26, that Strategy Inc. has reached a potential Bitcoin market capitulation point after its valuation relative to cryptocurrency holdings fell below a previous low.

data.title: Trump Says Wall Street’s ‘Pretty Big Dips’ on Wednesday Before Recovery Left Him ‘A Little Concerned,’ Credits Jensen Huang’s Return to Nvidia for Boosting Market Confidence
data.description: Trump says Wall Street's sharp selloff briefly concerned him, while touting his role in bringing Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang back.

data.title: ASML Caught in US-China Chip Battle as Netherlands Vows to Resist Trump’s Proposed Export Curbs: ‘We Will Not Simply Be Told What to Do’
data.description: The Dutch government plans to urge the U.S. not to impose proposed China export restrictions that could negatively affect chip equipment maker ASML and other European businesses if the MATCH Act is enacted.

data.title: US Can ‘Grow Its Way Out’ of Record Debt as It Did After WWII, Says Market Strategist, Predicts S&P at 10,000 Next Year: ‘Ignore the Doomers’
data.description: The U.S. can outgrow its record debt as it did after World War II, says Wellington Altus chief market strategist James Thorne.
